description: This file defines the ShareAccountTransaction entity class, representing share account transactions in a financial application, including transaction details, creation methods, status updates, and business logic.

classes.name: ShareAccountTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing transactions for share accounts, including purchase, redeem, and charge transactions with methods for status updates and charge management.

methods.name: createRedeemTransaction
methods.description: Static factory method to create a redeem share account transaction with approved status.

methods.name: createChargeTransaction
methods.description: Static factory method to create a charge transaction associated with a specific charge.

methods.name: undoApprove
methods.description: Reverts the transaction approval, setting it back to applied.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the transaction and adjusts amounts if there is a charge.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates transaction details such as date, total shares, and share value.

methods.name: updateChargeAmount
methods.description: Adds a total charge amount to the transaction.

methods.name: deductChargesFromTotalAmount
methods.description: Subtracts a total charge amount from the transaction's total.

methods.name: addShareAccountChargePaidBy
methods.description: Adds a record of charges paid by a party.

methods.name: updateTransactionDate
methods.description: Updates the date of the transaction.

methods.name: resetAmountPaid
methods.description: Resets the amount paid to zero.

methods.name: updateAmountPaid
methods.description: Increments or decrements the amount paid based on transaction type.
